nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist that lets an address bypass the condition() check.
uint256 private _minSale; minimum amount accepted by condition().
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum amount accepted by condition().
uint256 private _saleNum; maximum number of sales per address.
address tradeAddress; owner-settable address that is treated as whitelisted in ensure().
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spending approvals.
address private owner; privileged account controlling init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
uint public totalSupply; total token supply.
string public name; token name.
string public symbol; token symbol.
uint constant public decimals = 18; used in supply and sale-limit scaling.
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; hardcoded Uniswap router that is whitelisted in ensure().
function transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
function ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; applies the owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist and then condition().
function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; allowance check, ensure(), balance updates, _onSaleNum increment.
function approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
function condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; compares sale limits and per-address sale count.
function delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall.
function init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public returns(bool); owner-only, sets _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum but has no return statement.
function batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only mass transfer with unchecked multiplication and halved Transfer events.
function setTradeAddress(address addr) public returns(bool); owner-only setter of the whitelisted tradeAddress.
function pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure returns(address); CREATE2 pair address computation.
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; mints supply, sets owner and unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender; caller identity used for owner checks, allowance spending and balances.
a.delegatecall(b) with a user-supplied target and calldata executed in the token's storage context.
Whitelist short-circuit in ensure() that returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale senders without checking balance or condition().
batchSend credits full _value to each recipient while emitting two Transfer events of _value/2, and computes total without SafeMath.
init() is declared returns(bool) but never returns a value, so the call always reverts for callers expecting a boolean.

_to parameter of ensure().
_value parameter of ensure().
_from parameter of transferFrom().
_to parameter of transferFrom().
_value parameter of transferFrom().
_to parameter of transfer().
_value parameter of transfer().
a parameter of delegate(); delegatecall target.
b parameter of delegate(); delegatecall calldata.
_tos parameter of batchSend(); recipient array.
_value parameter of batchSend(); amount per recipient.
saleNum parameter of init().
token parameter of init(); minimum sale amount.
maxToken parameter of init(); maximum sale amount.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress(); new whitelisted address.
local _UNI inside ensure() holding the computed Uniswap pair address.
loop index i inside batchSend().
loop local _to inside batchSend() taken from _tos[i].

_value is only forwarded through transfer(), so it merges into the transfer core node.
